agency: Washington State Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), Economic Services Administration — Community Services Division
admin_note: State-administered through DSHS Community Services Offices; no county eligibility agencies. 'Basic Food' covers federal SNAP plus the state-funded Food Assistance Program (FAP) for certain non-citizens.

update_channels.name: Washington Administrative Code (WAC Title 388) via Washington State Register (WSR) amendments

verification.gates: Refute gate: 7 must-fix corrections found and applied before publication (resource-test scope, cash-CE qualifier, MCR dates, WASHCAP opt-out, ABAWD boundary).
